title: The Feed's empty sections become notices that point somewhere, and the Feed ends with Circles to explore (LIVE-1022)

source.ref: Owner design changes list 2026-10-19, items 23 and 24; screenshot 3:26 PM (thin italic empty lines under Near you and Needs you).

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-19. The Feed top was good; below it each empty section was a thin italic line and the stream stopped. A shared SystemNotice (components/frequency/members/shared/system-notice.tsx) now answers Needs you, Near you, the stream and the Story lens, each with a next step. ExploreSection (lib/feed/circles-to-explore.ts) adds three Circles to join: under Needs you for a member in fewer than three Circles, after the caught-up card otherwise. Covers plan row LIVE-1023 (item 23). Follow-on, not built: people to meet and marketplace picks sections.
